_about: Recursive Ekho: one schema for both lenses. Drafted Oct 11 2026 by the AI-readiness session, for the Recursive Gospels session to amend. Every node is a recursive.eco node (format v2) when it becomes a grammar; this file names the kinds and fields. Scaffolding (data/ is not published by the site). Nothing here is her final word.

world.name: Recursive Ekho
her_words: THe rammar of this world is called recursive map, it is my attempt to get oriented in this crazy world given unimaginable changes we will most likely fave. I will recursively chos emy grounds on how to have my moral compass and values so that I can keep making this life worth living in any scenario
I want people to find a cohesive system to remain hopeful in any circumstance though this world, practices and mytholgoy.
world.her_words_source: chat in the Recursive Gospels session, Oct 11 2026, as recorded verbatim in recursive-gospels/CLAUDE.md

lenses.sources: What is sourced: voices matched to captions or pages, endings whose names are borrowed labels, moves whose effects are ARGUED by a voice. No numbers about the world.
lenses.ekho: Her lore, marked as lore on every node. It may borrow from Sources and says where (source_lens + source_id). Death in the game ends an episode, not the player.

relations.given: Every chance belongs to an ending GIVEN a path of moves. Two kinds of effect: 'toy' (numbers inside a game that says so) and 'argued' (a direction with a voice behind it).
relations.together: Some moves count only when enough players make them (The Walk's coordination bar 0.60; 'Stopping needs company').

ending.is: where a walk could end; a basin, not a prophecy

move.is: what someone can do, who can do it, whether it needs company

condition.is: a move nobody chooses: something that happens to us

voice.is: who says so, at a time anyone can check; related to, never obeyed. In Ekho, a being is a voice inside the fiction.

word.is: what we call it, one meaning each; lives in glossary/terms.json

step.is: what I do now, private by default; in Ekho a place is where a step stands
fields: kept in the reader's browser or as a recursive.eco mark, never in this repo

principle.status: proposed by the Gospels session, for her
principle.is: a ground: an axiom the world rests on ('intelligence is pattern', 'we are made as we make'); her word 'grounds'

story.status: proposed by the Gospels session, for her (the Recursive Map calls it 'myth'; one word to pick with her)
story.is: a myth: an emergence whose parts are steps and endings; seeded by The Walk's 'ending as fiction' box

dial.status: proposed by the Gospels session (the Recursive Map's 'parameter' category), for her
dial.is: a quantity the players move by playing, unlike a wildcard, which nobody can set; today only relationality

wildcard.is: something science or experience might find that changes which endings are reachable and which strategies are adaptive. It has two or more faces and nobody knows yet which holds: The Fork's coin, the belief tree's questions, her four Ekho sliders read as unknowns, P3 'Name what is not known'.
wildcard.example: superintelligence is orthogonal to morality / it is not

her_words: Eventually i would like for people to be able to 1) create their own outcomes and select amongst existing, 2) create wildcare of what science or experience might find in the world 3) create strategies that might be adaptive at some or any point of the journey

For instance, learning how to die and wisdom serves us in any scenario. LEarn how to control our hubris and not launch unsafe product works only if superintelligence is orthogonal to morality or something you know? not sure
the world and the collective grammar will only accept things that are compassionate, fits the data and are useful, but amybe people can create their own grammars and it will render in the game
creation.her_words_source: chat in the AI-readiness session, Oct 11 2026, verbatim

three_creations.wildcard: a discovery that may come (kind above)

adaptive_when.any: robust: adaptive whichever face a wildcard shows (her example: learning how to die, wisdom)
adaptive_when.if: conditional: adaptive only under one face of a wildcard (her example, which she marked 'not sure': controlling hubris and not launching unsafe products, if superintelligence is orthogonal to morality)

creation.personal_grammar: anyone can make their own grammar of outcomes, wildcards and strategies; it renders in the game for them
creation.collective_grammar: accepts an entry only if it is compassionate, fits the data and is useful (her three tests); entries arrive as Offers waiting for review, the recursive.eco share-with-approval that already exists
creation.shared_assumptions: a small basic set every grammar inherits; to be named with her

oracles_in_the_game.status: her idea, Oct 12 2026; parked, nothing built
her_words: It would nbe funny if characters can cast our oracles in the game, especially something like human design and try to chose actions based on that, as a way that 4D communicates with them, but it can be red team lol

Like the only real test of oracles is if they can really help insituations like the ones we are going to face. Maybe we can cast the dhamappada if the moment is to face death or things like that, or people can chose to link a grammar to be tested in certain nodes
oracles_in_the_game.her_words_source: chat in the AI-readiness session, Oct 12 2026, verbatim
oracles_in_the_game.character_casts: a being casts one of the recursive.eco oracles at a choice and picks its move from the draw; marked red team, a test of the oracle, not advice to the player
oracles_in_the_game.linked_grammar: a node (a moment such as facing death) can link a grammar to cast there, e.g. the Dhammapada; the link is the one cross-link pattern (metadata.source_deck + source_node_id + deck)
oracles_in_the_game.the_test: an oracle earns its place if it helps in moments like the ones we may face; the game is where that is tried
oracles_in_the_game.uses: the recursive.eco cast tool draws; the game never invents a card

move_kinds._note: One list for both lenses. Her trainings first; The Walk's action kinds mapped where they line up; 'unmapped' left visible.

goodwill.her_words: an attitude towards aways wanting to do things that would directionally be beneficial for the whole, not only from our vantage point

processing.her_words: make sure we are able to compost the shadow in us so it can be expressed in adaptive forms towards others
processing.walk_kind: slack (unsure: slack is easing a hold, processing is composting; her call)

creative_work.her_words: One of the winning strategies is creative endeavours

ratchet.note: The Walk's kind with no training yet: locking a step in so it cannot slip back; unmapped in Ekho
